title: SBI Tata Neu Plus credit card

cardOverview.overviewText: A Tata Neu Plus card from SBI offering accelerated NeuCoins across Tata brands, unlimited airport lounge access, milestone vouchers, travel and lifestyle perks, designed for loyal Tata ecosystem users.

mileStoneItems.benefits: Get 499 NeuCoins on Tata Neu App (as reversal of 1st Year Membership Fees).Welcome Benefit will be available to claim inside Tata Neu App within 60 days of such transaction.
The renewal fee will be waived.
